conditions.text: Retail Operations must attempt to build an old-to-new product code mapping, or confirm that no mapping table exists, before any production analysis crossing the 2024 boundary
Analytics lead must choose and record the shop coordinates in outputs/artifacts/decisions.md before any real Open-Meteo archive probe runs
Legal must confirm production use and commercial use under CC BY 4.0 and the Copernicus C3S upstream licence for Open-Meteo archive

agreements.reason: INT-JOIN-KEY-MISMATCH is the largest single risk. No mapping table exists for codes retired in 2024. Feasible-with-conditions verdict is correct; production analysis cannot proceed until Retail Operations resolves the mapping gap.

Row count (~1500) does not match declared coverage (~1744 days from 2022-01-01). Feasible-with-conditions verdict is correct; Store Operations must reconcile the count before the calendar is used to distinguish closed days from missing data.

traced_conclusion.could_change_if: If Retail Operations confirms the sales table starts before 2022-01-01, the prototype window coverage for N1 and N2 would extend and the vintage of the pre-2024 code set would be larger, potentially making the name-based mapping more reliable.
